selectionMethod: Authored practical phrases, then lower-case 1–4-syllable dictionary headwords ranked by occurrences in source definitions/examples; not a validated usage-frequency ranking.
limits: Meaning proposals, not trained signs or a complete sign language.
Dictionary entries may have additional senses not selected here.
Unique display labels do not establish 6000 distinct linguistic concepts; synonyms and orthographic variants remain.
Every new sign and regional variant still needs linguistic review.
Source repository declares MIT; independent historical provenance of each sense was not audited.
note: Vietnamese aliases aid search only; they do not assert identical signs. Meaning count is not trained-class coverage.
